description: Canonical visual world for KI-channel generated images and B-roll so external/generated media feels native inside the Remotion reel system.
promptPrefix: Match the canonical KI-channel reel visual world: bright high-key editorial product-illustration aesthetic, clean premium 3D-inspired forms mixed with minimal realistic materials, white and very light lavender environment, soft purple brand accents, crisp modern tech/product-design language, calm depth, uncluttered composition, generous negative space, and a polished studio look that can sit naturally behind Remotion cards, icons and diagrams.
lighting: High-key soft studio lighting, bright neutral exposure, soft shadows, no crushed blacks, no dramatic low-key spotlighting.
composition: One clear subject or visual idea, clean hierarchy, simple background, controlled depth, enough empty space for 9:16 Remotion overlays and captions, no cluttered cinematic set dressing.
materials: Clean matte surfaces, glass/acrylic accents, subtle soft-metal details when useful; avoid dirty, rusty, distressed, workshop-grime or vintage textures unless the factual subject itself requires them.
motion: For B-roll use smooth deliberate camera motion and readable object/state changes; no handheld documentary look, no chaotic montage, no aggressive cinematic shake.
